0022600214.text: The Utah Jazz host the Miami Heat with the Jazz at 1-8, on a seven-game losing streak, 1-4 at home, and 14th in the West, while the Heat are 3-6, coming off a loss, and ninth in the East. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain), and Miami has no listed absences. The teams have not met yet this season, after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the Jazz won the most recent meeting 115-111 in Miami on February 9, 2026.
